P7644.corridor_notes: 文23-安庆天然气管道项目 (Wen23 gas storage-Anqing gas pipeline project), built/owned by 国家石油天然气管网集团有限公司西气东输分公司 (PipeChina West-East Gas Pipeline Branch). Per PipeChina's own Dec-2024 EIA public-participation notice: the whole project comprises 濮阳-亳州段 (Puyang-Bozhou, ~375.1km, = P7645), 亳州-淮南段 (Bozhou-Huainan, ~210.8km, = P7646), 淮南-安庆段 (Huainan-Anqing, ~265km, = P7647), plus two minor connectors not separately tracked as their own GEM rows: 濮阳联络站-鄂安沧管道连接线 (Puyang liaison station-E'anCang pipeline connector, 1.8km, co-trenched with the Wen23-storage-to-Puyang-liaison-station segment) and a 0.3km local reroute of the existing 西二线平泰支干线 at 菏泽分输清管站 (Heze, Shandong) so that line passes through a newly built 菏泽联络压气站. Total NEW pipe = 642.2km (=375.1+265+1.8+0.3; the 210.8km Bozhou-Huainan stretch is explicitly EXCLUDED from the new-build total because it reuses an existing/parallel corridor rather than laying new pipe there — see P7646 notes). The whole line starts at the existing Wen23 underground gas storage (converted from the depleted Wen23 gas field, in 中原油田/Zhongyuan Oilfield territory, Puyang, Henan) and ends at Anqing Liaison Station, Anhui, crossing Henan, Shandong (via the Heze reroute) and Anhui.
P7644.researcher_notes: P7644 is the parent/whole-line row; its route is the concatenation of P7645 (Puyang-Bozhou) + P7646 (Bozhou-Huainan) + P7647 (Huainan-Anqing), plus two minor sub-1.8km connectors PipeChina's notice lists but that do not appear to have their own GEM rows (a Puyang-liaison-station-to-鄂安沧-pipeline tie-in, and a 0.3km reroute of an unrelated existing line — 西二线平泰支干线 — near Heze, Shandong, to accommodate a new Heze liaison compressor station). Not a duplicate of the segment rows (different granularity — whole line vs. sub-segments), so duplicate_of is left null per instructions. GEM's LengthMergedKm (643.20) is close to but not identical to PipeChina's official total (642.2km, or 852.7km if you sum all three named segments without excluding the reused Bozhou-Huainan stretch) — a ~1km rounding/version difference, not flagged as material. Sheet's StartProvince/EndProvince (Henan/Anhui) match the source.
